thread:
Sasha: quick heads-up — noticed attribution drift after we started compacting traces with the new slice window. ingest drops ~25% of pre-enrich keys and enrichment emits new rows with null billing_key. Need a short sync on interface tradeoffs.

Raj: can you paste a minimal example of the envelope that loses the key?

Sasha: here's a redacted sample (simplified) — compactor output missing billing key:
```json
{
  \"trace_id\": \"abc123\",
  \"spans\": [...],
  \"compact\": true,
  \"attributes\": {\"service\": \"gw\"}
}
```

Raj: ah, enrichment attaches billing_key later so compacted row never sees it. high-level options: 1) carry a tiny cost_hint at edge that survives compaction 2) emit a pre-enrich attribution event before compaction 3) materialize a join table in storage to map compacted ids -> billing_key for attribution.

Emily: Option 1 seems lowest-latency and least storage-y. where would cost_hint live? header on envelope? edge-proxy?

Sasha: yeah edge-proxy or SDK adds header like `cost_hint:acct-<short>` (very small token). compactor preserves header into compacted envelope. enrichment can still attach full billing_key later but attribution pipeline reads cost_hint first.

Dan: main worry is cardinality and accidental leakage. if cost_hint is too granular we blow up storage and query cost. suggest: cost_hint = salted_hash(acct_id, n_buckets) + provenance tag. TTLed.

Maya: also consider schema change: optional `cost_hint` field in ingest contract so all downstream consumers know where to look. keeps it explicit.

TelemetryBot: deploy-bot: compact-slicer v2 rolled out to us-west yesterday (no errors). :white_check_mark:

Raj: tradeoffs recap: header is minimally invasive but needs contract & compactor changes. pre-enrich event avoids changing compacted envelope but doubles events and increases ingest. mapping table keeps privacy but adds reads/joins in attribution. we need perf numbers.

Emily: propose a pragmatic prototype: add cost_hint at edge (2-char bucket + 6-char salt hash) and preserve through compactor. run 1% traffic A/B for 48h and compare attribution recovery and query cost. i'll sketch telemetry and dashboard.

Sasha: can you draft a quick A/B config?

Emily: sample config (very rough):
```yaml
ab_tests:
  cost_hint_prototype:
    cohort: 1%
    edge_config:
      add_cost_hint: true
      hint_format: "bucket-${salted_hash}%8"
    compactor_config:
      preserve_fields: ["cost_hint","provenance"]
    retention:
      cost_hint_ttl_days: 7
```

Dan: couple of add-ons: 1) enforce pseudonymization for cost_hint via KMS-salted hash before emitting, 2) ensure compactor de-duplicates stale hints on merge, 3) set TTL 7 days as Emily suggested.

Raj: if we go mapping-table route later, use sparse Bloom-index to avoid heavy joins. but let's start cheap. also we should document query-side fallback: if billing_key missing, read cost_hint mapping then attribute.

Sasha: agreed. I'll open an RFC PR with: ingest-contract optional `cost_hint` field, compactor preserve rule, A/B rollout plan, telemetry queries to measure attribution delta and query cost. tagging reviewers: @Raj @Emily @Dan @Maya. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Emily: I'll drop the telemetry dashboard link in the RFC once it's up.

Raj: 👍

Maya: thanks — will review the RFC and add privacy checklist items.

Sasha: closing for now, RFC coming in ~30m.
